optionA_phone_ready_direct.label: Use this on your phone now (recommended)
optionA_phone_ready_direct.note: Get key at https://openrouter.ai/keys. Works from phone, no PC needed. Paid after free credits; mock portal keys (mk-...) will NOT work here.

optionB_via_portal.label: Via this portal gateway (needs your own PC on same WiFi)
steps: On your PC: PORT=3002 node magnum-key-portal/server.js
On your PC: open http://localhost:3002, Create key, copy mk-...
Find PC LAN IP: Windows ipconfig / Linux hostname -I (e.g. 192.168.1.42)
On phone studio app: Model=anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b, Base=http://192.168.1.42:3002/v1, Key=mk-...
Without OPENROUTER_API_KEY the gateway returns mock demo text. For real Magnum: OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... PORT=3002 node magnum-key-portal/server.js
